name: Breffu
biography: Breffu was an Akwamu woman who led the 1733 St. John slave revolt, one of the earliest and longest-lasting slave rebellions in the Americas. Enslaved on a plantation in Coral Bay, she masterminded the takeover of the Danish fort at Frederiksberg and held control of the island for nearly six months.
notes: She is recognized as the 'Queen of St. John' and a heroic figure who chose to take her own life rather than submit to recapture by French and Swiss troops.
